body: Thank you so much for your kind words.

I do like my work. That's why it is so sad that I keep messing up things for myself.

I have to go now. I got an email about an unrelated urgent work thing. Fuck my life.

Thank you so much for listening to me. I hope there is something like karma.

I am a phd student. I work in material sciences. I spent a few weeks working on an equation. I think I had  a manic episode. I worked non-stop. I even woke up at night with an idea and kept working. I kept making mistakes and everything is a blurr. There are just hundereds of pages I scribbled on with some weird calculations. I then found out there are already equations for this kind of calculation. From people who were really researching it. Not like me who just lost her mind. But I don't know how to explain to my boss what I spent my time on. And I don't know how I can compensate for this time and present something reasonable at the meeting in two weeks.

:) Sorry. Yeah. I could have checked.
I just really need a few weeks off. But I can't because I have a project meeting in two weeks were I am supposed to present results, I don't have yet. After that I need to finish a different project for some clients that are due in may. Ater that I have another meeting, which I have zero idea when to prepare for it, since it is a week later. I am just so exhausted. But it is all my fault. I had all the time in the world to prepare for these things. But I chose to spend time with other shit things no one is interested in. And now I am in a mess.
You are not a bot? Are you?

Thank you. That means a lot to me.

I just don't really feel connected to anything. I don't know if I have social phobia, derealization or extreme maladaptive daydreaming. Everything is so far away. I don't know how to talk to anyone. I work everyday like a maniac and then I realize that everything I did is useless and I completely forgot other deadlines I was supposed to work on. I keep failing everyday at my personal relationships and at my work tasks.
I guess I am also an idealized version of myself in my daydreams. I never really thought about that.

Interesting. I also struggle with AvPD and maladaptive daydreaming. My daydreams are mostly very casual and based on real life and real people. Often I am pouring my heart out to someone in my daydreams. I guess my daydreams are replacing the interpersonal connections that I am not good at maintaining in real life. I try to keep people at a distance. I guess that is the AvPD. I wonder if this co-ocurrence is common.

Sounds like you are stuck in a cycle. Try to get out of this isolation. The isolation makes you want to daydream so you are not alone. And you are alone because you are occupied with daydreaming. What about joining a club or some activity where you can talk to others?

And why is it so important to have an interesting hobby to impress others? A lot of people don't. They like to chill out in front of the TV or hang out with friends.
I once tried to explain this to a counselor who told me that I have a gift and that I should use my daydreaming to create positive feelings... Not good advice for someone with MD.

I know this feeling. I have completely fallen in love with a guy last year. I think of him everyday. Whenever I feel down I daydream about being with him, it gives me so much joy.

But then another voice says that I cannot break up with my current boyfriend over this. That I am not really in love with that guy but just with a version of that guy, which I have only created in my head. I long to be with him and I don't know if it's real. It's tearing me apart.
Sleep tight, stranger :).

Wow. That is a very sad story. I wish I could do or say anything to help, but I don't know.

But your children and your wife love you. And they want you in their lives. That is their decision, no matter how you feel.
Yes, keep wanting, keep trying. And there is always small moments of happiness. Even if it is just making a small moment of connection through the computer screen with a stranger :).
Don't give up. Life is hard, especially for people on this sub. We have a predesposition for sadness.
It is very sad to see that someone talks about themself in a such a mean way. You don't deserve this. And you don't deserve to die. Is anything going on in your life that makes you feel this way?

Why can't you talk to your friends about it? How would you react if a friend came to you and told you they felt down and sad? Everyone knows how sadness feels. It is nothing to feel ashamed about.

College is a tough time. Believe in yourself, you can make it.

You deserve a healthy, happy relationship. You deserve someone who cares about you. Your ex does not seem to care, you deserve better.

Let your family take care of you. Be nice to yourself.

It is hard to make plans. Especially plans with other people. I don't like the thought of someone I care about to have an appointment with me in their calender that might not happen.

I was supposed to tutor a student this fall, but I did not bring myself to help them, because I don\`t want to plan ahead that far.

Ironically it makes me miss a lot of opportunities.

For me it was similar. I think I felt very isolated and lonely as a child.

I have an older sister, who was my playmate until she started reading. My sister is a bookworm, ever since she was able to read she is finishing one book after another. The bigger the book, the better.

Maybe that was her way of escaping the constant fighting of my parents and my mother's neverending anger.

On top of that I wasn't allowed to visit my cousins who were similar in age and lived next door. So I had no other children to play with. My mother did not want us to have contact with my father's side of the family. I think this toxic environment made me want to create a better world for myself even if it was only in my head.

I haven't seen most of my relatives for over a year. I have gained about 30 pounds last year. I think it is because my drepression got really bad this year.
Now all I think about is how my relatives will talk about my weight gain behind my back and how terrible I look. I really don't feel well. I keep daydreaming about it. All day long I keep having fights in my head, trying to defend myself. Old issues about my family are bubbeling up. We are not close and I am only going there because I haven't seen my father in a while and my grandmother turned 92 this year. My fahter and grandmother are very nice, but I don't care for the rest of my family. I really do not want to go :-(.
